candidates.notes: Abstract confirms 940 MWe output, 75–85% availability assumptions, and electricity cost estimates. Does not state thermal efficiency % explicitly in abstract. Extracted for content check.

candidates.title: The heat transport system and plant design for the HYLIFE-2 fusion reactor
candidates.notes: Abstract mentions scoping study for intermediate heat exchanger geometry and cost of electricity, but no numerical efficiency data visible. Full text not available on OSTI.

gaps_attempted.notes: HYLIFE-II final report abstract captured (economics, availability model) but does not explicitly state thermal efficiency %. candidates.notes: Araiinejad 2025 is about MFE tokamak (ARC/ARAI concept), not IFE. FLiBe cost may appear in blanket section but context is MFE, not HYLIFE. Full text paywalled.

candidates.title: Assessment of the lifecycle cost of nuclear-grade coolants for advanced reactors
candidates.notes: Directly relevant — analyzes FLiBe lifecycle cost with $/kg CAPEX and $/year per MW OPEX. Abstract confirms FLiBe is one of seven coolants studied. Full text paywalled on ScienceDirect.

candidates.title: Flibe Coolant Cleanup and Processing in the HYLIFE-II Inertial Fusion Energy Power Plant
candidates.notes: Focused on processing methodology (volatility separation, centrifugation, chemical separation) for removing target debris from molten salt. Contains gold/gadolinium target material costs but not FLiBe coolant cost per kg.

summary.notes: G-10 and G-11 closed with available/extracted sources. G-2 and G-12 partially addressed by HYLIFE-III (already extracted) and HYLIFE-II biblio. G-7 (FLiBe/FLiNaK cost) is the most intractable gap — the best candidate is paywalled and no open FLiNaK cost-per-kg source exists in indexed literature.
